Dialogs.Dialog: Pretty much. I thought I'd try reading somewhere different for once.
I see. Running into you when I least expect it makes me kind of happy.
Nothing. I was about to head home anyway.
I don't want to interrupt your reading. See you.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. We keep running into each other here.
Well, it's close by, isn't it？ Don't you have anywhere else to go？
It's a classic spot. Besides, I got to see ▲小早川＊▲, so it was worth coming.
It doesn't have to be by chance. If you want to see me, you can... Idiot.
Hey, what a coincidence. Did ▲小早川＊▲ come to see a movie too？
Yeah, but... what about you？ Alone？
Yeah, alone. Huh, I figured ▲小早川＊▲ didn't watch many movies. That's a surprise.
Th-That's not it. A book I like just happened to get made into a movie...
Oh. You could've invited me. I'd have come along.
But... the original's pretty niche... You probably wouldn't get it...
Some movies I want to watch alone, okay？ ...Well, I'm going.
▲小早川＊▲. Another favorite book made into a movie？
W-Well, something like that. There seem to be a lot lately... Bye.
(The one showing here is a romance movie, isn't it？)
We meet again. So you do watch a lot of movies.
Um... romance movies and stuff. I've gotten kind of into them, hehe. Is that weird？
Huh... What are you doing in a place like this？
Since when do you come to places like this？
I should be asking you. Aren't you bad at sports？
Yeah, but... lately, I figured I'd try getting in shape.
Hmph. Sadly, Rinko has no need for such things.
Lately I've been feeling out of shape. Especially when I play with my little brother.
Ah. Kids have crazy stamina when they play.
So Rinko's building up her stamina. Might boost her kicking power too？
We meet again. Huh, still on your stamina plan？ You're really sticking with it.
Yeah. Even now, Rinko's still the first to give up when we play.
I see. Your brother's that energetic, huh.
Yeah. He's so cute, but he's a boy after all. Maybe you should learn from him？
I'll think about it. See you.
Yeah. I'm a total regular now.
Nice. It's good you've made a habit of moving around.
Thanks to that, playing with my brother is more fun now. Hehe.
Rinko's done shopping and heading home. And you're... wandering around because you're bored. Right？
Not at all. I may not look it, but I'm pretty busy.
And then browsing at the bookstore...
Wow, sounds super busy. Rinko won't get in your way. Heading home now.
▲主人公＊▲. We meet again. Free again today？
Then let me ask. What are you busy with this time？
How about... being my girlfriend's bodyguard？
Hey, if it isn't ▲小早川＊▲. We keep meeting here.
Well, yeah. Girls have a lot to deal with, you know.
I could ask you that. Is today's event your kind of thing, ▲小早川＊▲？
It's not about liking it. I'm just trying out all kinds of stuff.
I see. It's good to experience lots of things while you're young.
What's that？ Are you a teacher now？
But whatever the event, there are always so many people. Doesn't it get to you？
If there's no path, make one.
What are we even doing？ We should just come here on a date.
Then we just go on dates too. Simple as that.
Going out doesn't mean we have to be all over each other all the time. That's lame.
We keep running into each other at stuff like this. Since when do you like events？
That's my line, ▲小早川＊▲. I'd have thought you'd find this a pain.
So what？ Rinko's changed a little.
Well, compared to when we first met...
But that's definitely your fault, you know.
▲小早川＊▲. Here to play by yourself？
Want to play？ Rinko'll take you on.
What, you think losing to your girlfriend would be embarrassing？ Isn't that sexist？
(Ugh, I lost. My opponent's on a winning streak. No way I can win this.)
I thought you might spot me by my habits, but you don't know your girlfriend that well yet, huh？
Come on, not by your gaming habits...
Not enough training. Come back when you're ready.
I didn't think so, but... Yep, there she is.
Yeah. Sorry, it's always Rinko playing games. Isn't it boring for you？
It's fine. You like it, right？
Yeah, well. Then my next win is a present for you.
▲小早川＊▲. Funny place to run into you.
Yeah. I came to look at the new portable players.
Hm, you want a new one？
Not really. Mine still works fine.
I just like looking at AV gear in stores like this. Not that I know much about it.
Huh. A lot of girls aren't into that kind of stuff, though.
What's up？ Looking at home appliances？ Getting ready to be a bride or something...
I just thought I should help my mom out more. Bye.
Don't make it sound like I live here. By that logic, ▲小早川＊▲...
They'll play CDs you bring from home in the audio section. Not that I'm buying anything.
What a coincidence. Though it's no surprise to see ▲小早川＊▲ here.
Don't talk like I'm simple. I don't want my moves predicted that easily.
So, what？ Buying CDs again today？
I'm not here ALL the time.
Just looking today. That's fun enough, though. Want to come along？
I'll head home. Having someone next to you who doesn't get it won't help.
Fine. You don't have to force yourself to get Rinko's hobbies. Understanding Rinko is enough.
▲主人公＊▲. Just listening to samples today.
Huh, how long have you been here？
That long？ Don't be a nuisance to the store.
Huh...？ What are you doing here？
That's my line. Do you like stores like this？
That's just what I wanted to ask you.
Rinko came to get her little brother a present... but this stuff is so confusing.
Totally agree. But depending on what it is, I can help look.
Rinko wants something from "Ultra Combiner Volvavin."
▲小早川＊▲. Another request from your brother？
Oh... yeah. He says he wants a different one.
My brother's cute, so I can't help it.
Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲!? No, I was just passing by...！
More importantly, what are you doing here, ▲小早川＊▲!?
There's a niche record store in this building. I was just stopping by.
Um, my dentist is in this building. I have an appointment.
Yeah, yeah, something like that. And regular checkups.
You take the train all the way here for a dentist？
Y-Yeah, it has to be this one！ See you！
Th-This is a handy shortcut to all kinds of places！
Huh. So you're just passing through here, right？
Of course！ Well, I'm in a hurry.
Sorry, denied. I'm in a hurry！
I can always spot you, even from far away.
